title: Free shipping threshold is not reflected in the order summary
description: An order at exactly $50 appears to retain a shipping fee in both calculation and display.

report.expected: At a $50 subtotal, Shipping should be $0.00 and Total should be $50.00.
report.actual: Shipping shows $5.00 and the order total includes it.
report.context: Fresh browser storage; free shipping begins at $50.

steps: An order at exactly $50 appears to retain a shipping fee in both calculation and display.
